articles.summary: Added approximately 8,500 net new Locations in third quarter Annualized recurring run-rate (ARR) grew 24% to $2.5 billion as of September 30, 2026 Net income was $169 million and Adjusted EBITDA was $240 million in third quarter Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurants and retail businesses, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We had another strong quarter: recurring gross profit streams 1 grew 27%, GAAP Operating Income margin 2 expanded to 26% and we added approximately 8,500 net locations,” said Toast CEO Aman Narang. “With our Fall Release, we expanded Toast IQ Grow and launched Toast IQ Team, moving Toast beyond tools that help operators run their business toward agents that take on the work for them. articles.title: Toast Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
